name: AseClient0SybaseAse16
description: Sybase ASE as pengdows.crud testbed runs it (SybaseTestContainer): a device and a database created before the tests, retried while ASE copies its model database. ASE starts with the -T11889 trace flag (SAP KBA 3018138), as testbed's SIGSEGV workaround does.

setup: EXEC sp_dboption testdb, 'allow nulls by default', true

types.query: SELECT name, CASE WHEN name IN ('char','varchar','nchar','nvarchar','binary','varbinary','unichar','univarchar') THEN name + '(100)' WHEN name IN ('decimal','numeric') THEN name + '(28,10)' ELSE name END FROM systypes WHERE usertype < 100
